**This release changes the database schema.** `UPGRADE_MIN_DATE` is raised, so every installation goes through the upgrade wizard once, including installations already running 3.2.4.5.
* **Back up your database before upgrading**, as always.

* **Email templates.** *Access request to an item* is no longer listed in *Configuration → Email templates*, because nothing sends that email any more. A customization saved for it stays in the database, unused.
* **Back up your database before upgrading**, as always.

* **A manual backup needs an encryption key.** Earlier releases accepted an empty key on the on-the-fly backup and then wrote the database dump unencrypted. An empty key, or one longer than 4,096 bytes, is now refused. The key is used exactly as typed. Earlier releases turned `& < > " '` into HTML entities before using it. The last page of the installer and of the web upgrade wizard, and the disaster recovery finalization, now run a fresh permission audit on the server and display the correction commands. The first public release of pemba: an embedded, Zanzibar-style authorization engine in Rust with Python bindings. It runs inside your process and keeps relationships in your own SQLite database, so a permission write can join your application's transaction and commit or roll back with your data. `check`, `lookup_resources`, `lookup_subjects`, the memory and SQLite stores, transactional writes and the Python bindings are implemented and tested.

### Fixed
- Journal: pressing Esc no longer throws away an entry you were writing. Esc does not close the dialog while there is unsaved text, and what you type is also kept as a draft on this device, so it comes back if the dialog is closed anyway. Cancel still discards it.

### Changed
- Home: the top of the page is now a row that can hold two cards side by side (stacked on a phone). The sleep battery moved there, next to the daily quote, instead of sitting at the bottom.
- Sleep: the battery card on Home has the "Lights off now" and "I'm up now" buttons, so you can log your evening and your morning without opening the Sleep page. The percentage is smaller, with "estimate" in the title, so it reads as information and not as a score.

### Changed
- Review: the bars of the six areas now grow smoothly from empty, one after another, when you open the review, change week or month, or tap a day. With "reduce motion" turned on in your device they simply appear.

### Fixed
- Umbrel: the five icon images (`apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `icon-maskable-512.png` and `favicon.svg`) are now served without the Umbrel login. An iPhone asks for the icon without being signed in, so before this it received the login page and added a plain placeholder to the Home Screen. Nothing else is opened: every other path still needs the Umbrel login.

### Changed
- The interface files (scripts and styles) are now sent compressed when the browser accepts it, about three times smaller. This helps most on a slow connection, such as a phone on 5G, each time a new version is downloaded. The API, fonts and images are left as they are.

### Changed
- Home: the card that invites you to read last month's recap can be hidden with a cross, and it goes away by itself once you have opened that recap. It still only shows in the first week of a month (two weeks in January for the year).
- Sleep: the battery no longer shows a number when your last logged wake-up is more than 24 hours old. A night you forgot to log made it look as if you had been awake for a day and a half. It now asks you to log last night, and says "Last night logged" with its dat

### Fixed
- Sleep: the battery now charges while you sleep. When you have logged "Lights off" but not the wake-up yet, it shows "Asleep since ..." and goes up, instead of ignoring the night and keeping on falling.
- Sleep: the Log a night window proposes tomorrow when you open it in the evening, and shows the whole night in words ("From Mon 2 November at 23:30 to Tue 3 November at 07:00"), so a night saved under the wrong day is easy to spot. The battery reads a night saved a day too early as a very long ti

### Added
- Sleep plugin (off until you turn it on in Settings > Plugins): log when you turned the lights off and when you got up, by hand at any time (the app does not need to be on when you wake) or with a tap on "Lights off now" and "I'm up now". A night belongs to the day you woke up. Routes under `/api/v1/plugins/sleep`.
- Sleep: a battery on Home and on the Sleep page. It is an estimate from a simplified two-process model of sleep pressure (it rises while you are awake and falls while you sleep), show

### Added
- People plugin (off until you turn it on in Settings > Plugins): a private list of people with their name and birthday, sorted by the next birthday, with "turns N" when you know the year. It never creates points and never sends a notification. Routes under `/api/v1/plugins/people`.

### Changed
- Review: the view buttons and the arrows now sit below the title and no longer move when the title gets longer or shorter; the "This week / month / year" button keeps its width.
- Review: the report of a

### Added
- New activity: a "Need ideas?" link under the name opens a few suggestions for the chosen area (about five per area: for example "Write to someone I care about", "Call a friend or a family member" twice a week, "See someone in person" once a week). Tapping one fills the name, the weight and the weekly goal; you can change everything before saving. Suggestions are in English and Italian.
